settings.heading: Run by friends, powered by dogs
settings.text: Stray Dog started with a crew of friends who grew up on the water — fishing, surfing, and picking up strays along the way.
settings.text2: Every piece is made to be lived in: heavyweight cotton, coastal colors, and the signature stray script.

settings.heading: Rescue first
settings.text: A portion of every sale is donated to dog rescues and shelters.

settings.heading: Made for the water
settings.text: Built by a crew of friends who live on boats, boards, and beaches.

settings.heading: The pack
settings.text: Real people, real dogs, real trips — our community wears the brand.

settings.heading: Working with local rescues
settings.text: We team up with rescues and shelters along the coast to fund food, vet care, and adoptions. Partner list announced on our socials.
